question: How is the round altar constructed according to the stated method?
premises: A specific reduction involving the neck measure is prescribed.
This reduction yields a particular altar form.
The resulting form is stated to be a round altar.
inference: By abandoning a half-eighth of the neck measure, the round altar is produced as stated here.
uncertainties: The technical meaning of kaṇṭha in this geometric context is uncertain.
plain_english: By leaving out a half-eighth of the neck measure, the round altar is produced, as stated here.
